description: Hanging your slacks or jeans and keeping them crease-free is made easy with the Slack Hangers. The hanger’s open end allows you to easily slip your slacks on and off the hangers without taking them off your clothing rack. Constructed with a chrome plated metal finish, the non-slip surface and sure grip arm prevents your slacks from slipping off. One set includes 12 hangers.
